a guide on how to be
a better man

1. if someone holds the door...
thank them

small respect, every day.

2. if your dad tells the same story...
listen like it's the first time

3. if a friend is quiet...
ask twice

the second "how are you" matters.

4. if you don't understand something...
learn it

don't fake it.
